subject.title: fix: respect local Crabbox provider preferences

question: Should ordinary trusted validation preserve OpenClaw’s repository Testbox default unless an explicit environment or CLI override is supplied, or should Crabbox gain a persistent operator-preference layer above repository configuration?
rationale: The requested user-configuration behavior conflicts with Crabbox’s documented cross-repository precedence contract, so implementation cannot safely choose the permanent policy without owner intent.

options.title: Preserve Repository Precedence
options.body: Keep Testbox as the repository default and require `CRABBOX_PROVIDER` or `--provider` when an operator wants another eligible backend.

options.title: Sponsor Upstream Preference
options.body: Define and test a new Crabbox operator-preference layer above repository configuration before consuming it in OpenClaw.

recommendation.title: Preserve Repository Precedence
recommendation.body: Keep Testbox as the repository default and require `CRABBOX_PROVIDER` or `--provider` when an operator wants another eligible backend.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent OpenClaw wrapper ownership and upstream Crabbox configuration history make this the strongest available owner for the precedence decision.
